independence: Source editor and learner author; did not author or typeset the separate answer-key master. Reviewed accepted key pages without modifying either master, TeX, contract, prior reviews or shared files.
method: All 26 final v1 images were opened through view_image with original detail and directly inspected in full, in batches of two or three. Every final image and the current PDF were independently checked against the supplied manifest after inspection. Hashing bound the identities to the actual inspection; it did not replace visual review.
